metadata.note: Framing facts for the two scoping slides. Every figure carries its date, its population, its citation keys and its counterpoint. The bibliography itself lives in references.bib and nowhere else.

source_kinds.primary: the study itself was opened and read
source_kinds.reported-in: the finding is reported by the cited source, whose own primary reference was not opened

metadata.bibliography: references.bib, in this folder. A source carries citation KEYS only: the printable sentence is derived from the BibTeX entry, never copied here.

no_faculty_data.en: No survey measures generative-AI adoption faculty by faculty at the University of Luxembourg. Every figure here comes from studies run elsewhere — mostly the United Kingdom and the United States — and describes a discipline, not this institution. Read them as what your field is already living through, not as a measurement of this room.

headline.en: Nobody has measured this at our University.
